LanguageData.CC_Theme_None_Tip: The room as its plan was drawn: the furniture, materials and floor the planner picks from your stock.
LanguageData.CC_Theme_Tip:
The look the room is built in. The style decides how much goes in; the theme decides what it looks like: the furniture, the walls and the floor. The layout stays the same, and a piece is only swapped for one of the same size and shape.
A theme uses only what the colony can build and has enough of; the rest stays as planned. Picking a theme starts the materials over, like "Use what we have", and anything you pick after that wins.

LanguageData.CC_Theme_NoSwaps: None of this room's furniture changes yet, only the walls and floor where the colony has the materials.
